entryPoints.description: Entry files, relative to the workspace root (or cwd).

outfile.description: Output file (`--outfile`). Takes precedence over `outputPath`. Use with `compile` for a single executable.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the workspace root.

packages.description: Bundle dependencies or keep them external.

plugins.description: Bun plugins: module paths (relative to the workspace root) whose default export is a BunPlugin, an array of them, or a function returning either. Switches the build to `Bun.build()` since `bun build` has no plugin flag; `args` is not supported then.

clean.description: Delete `outputPath` (or `outfile`) before building. Must be inside the workspace.

generatePackageJson.description: Write a package.json next to the output. Dependencies are taken from the project graph (all with `packages: external`, otherwise only those listed in `external`).

dts.description: Emit .d.ts files with tsc next to the output.

assets.description: Files or folders copied into the output directory (relative to the workspace root).
